title: Build Comparator
description: Side-by-side comparison tool for warframe builds at /compare. Allows players to evaluate stat differences across loadouts.

title: Helminth Subsume Planner
description: Interactive planner at /helminth-planner for choosing which warframe abilities to subsume and infuse. Covers all 50+ subsumed abilities.

title: Build Calculator
description: Stat calculator at /build-calculator that computes effective HP, DPS, and other derived stats from mod selections. WFCD data-backed.

title: Damage Type Chart
description: Reference chart at /damage-types showing all 15 damage types, their status procs, and faction-specific modifiers (Grineer, Corpus, Infested, Corrupted).

title: Star Chart Visualization
description: Interactive star chart at /star-chart visualizing all planets, nodes, and mission types. Helps new players navigate the progression path.

title: Riven Roll Planner
description: Riven mod roll planner at /riven-planner showing expected stat ranges per disposition and kuva cost per reroll cycle.

title: Modular Weapon Builder
description: Modular weapon assembly tool at /modular-builder for Kitguns, Zaws, and Moa companions. Computes final stats from chosen components.

title: Market Price Ticker
description: Live platinum price ticker at /market sourcing warframe.market data via the shared fetch token-bucket. Shows buy/sell spreads for tradeable items.

title: Light/Dark Theme Toggle
description: Persistent light/dark mode toggle in the site header. Preference stored in localStorage; respects prefers-color-scheme on first visit.

title: PWA Installable + Offline
description: Progressive Web App manifest and service worker enabling installation on mobile/desktop and offline access to cached content pages.

title: Live Worldstate Widget
description: Live worldstate dashboard at /worldstate showing current sorties, void fissures, invasions, and Arbitrations via warframestat.us polling.

title: Frame Relationship Graph
description: Interactive graph visualizing synergies between warframes — e.g. which frames pair well for disruption, ESO, or endurance runs. Nodes are frames, edges are synergy tags.

title: What To Do At MR X Recommender
description: Personalized progression recommender that takes a mastery rank input and surfaces the most impactful quests, weapons, and frames to unlock next. Driven by WFCD masteryReq data.

title: Fashion-Frame Gallery
description: Community-facing gallery of colour-palette and skin combinations for each warframe. Submissions stored as static JSON; no server-side rendering required.

title: Clan Dojo Planner
description: Tool for planning dojo room layouts and tracking research resource costs. Renders room adjacency as an editable graph with running material totals.

title: Drop Chance Monte Carlo (Relic Refinement Sim)
description: Statistical simulator for relic refinement drop probabilities. Runs Monte Carlo trials to show expected runs to obtain a given prime part at each refinement tier.
